summary: Alma Mater casts players as heads of a Renaissance university competing to recruit professors and students and build prestige across four academic disciplines. It's a dense euro of worker placement and drafting with an engine-building feel, aimed at experienced gamers.
praised: rich thematic integration of academic life
deep interlocking systems for building an engine
criticised: steep learning curve and dense rulebook
iconography and complexity can feel overwhelming

interaction.kind: worker placement and shared market competition
interaction.detail: Players compete for shared action spaces and a shared pool of students and professors to recruit, but each player's scoring engine and university tableau develops independently.

sources: reputation gained on the four discipline tracks
scoring.how_you_win: You recruit professors and students and advance your university's standing across four academic disciplines over a set number of rounds; final reputation from all tracks plus graduated students and bonus tiles is totalled, and the highest score wins.
